summary: Post-patch structural lint whose output is a rebuild trigger, not a warning — so any check it fails must be fixable by rebuilding, or the keeper loops. assertedFile encodes that trade-off explicitly: bare extends/implements targets are exempt from the file-existence check because flagging them would make every repo with inheritance rebuild forever, and the same reasoning applies to any new edge kind whose endpoints are not guaranteed to be indexed files.
